children: Zillow said engaged home shoppers per listing fell to 3.5 nationally in Q3 2026, down 4.8% year over year and the lowest since tracking began in H2 2023. Rental demand rose 22.1% year over year in October.
Q3 shoppers per listing: 3.5, down 4.8% YoY
Zillow's tracked measure hit a record low, signaling weaker buyer engagement across most large metro areas.
Engagement fell YoY in 44 of 50 large metros
The broad decline suggests the demand slowdown is not limited to a small number of local markets.
The report points to rental demand absorbing some would-be buyers; no prior-period level was provided.
The decline was concentrated among starter homes, while luxury engagement was flat year over year.

This is a current housing-market demand update, with Zillow's shopper-engagement measure at a new low amid rising mortgage rates and higher inventory. Further declines in mortgage rates or a sustained rebound in shopper engagement and home sales would clarify whether demand is recovering.
